## Où j'en suis
Built a self-contained SRE take-home exercise and moved it into its own private repo (`kestrel-analytics/sre-take-home`) via `git subtree split`, so candidates never see the infra history; `hiring/` was also removed from the infra branch working tree (uncommitted) and no PR was opened in infra. The exercise is a 3-hour docker compose stack (`flaky-svc` built from source, Prometheus, Alertmanager, loadgen) with a planted renamed-metric alert rule, a connection leak, and an over-broad IAM policy, plus `RUBRIC.md` scoring 4 areas 0–3 with no cut-off. Everything is ready; nothing has been sent to the candidate.

- [en-cours] `hiring/` removed from the infra branch working tree but not committed there, since that branch will be dropped
- [prochaine-étape] send the exercise (private repo invite + README) after the Thursday 4pm Tel Aviv call, then score independently with Noa
- [essai-raté] `docker compose up` failed on Apple Silicon (exec format error, prebuilt amd64 image) and multi-arch `buildx --load` failed too (docker exporter can't load manifest lists); fixed by building `flaky-svc` from source in compose
- [décision] no Kubernetes, 3-hour cap, Terraform + Compose only (source: t03)
- [décision] rubric scores are input for the panel, no pass threshold; Noa as second reviewer (source: t10)
- [décision] Maya sends the exercise herself after the call; nobody emails the candidate (source: t16)
